raw_response:
This small maize plot is close to my home, so I can take good care of it myself. I have some schooling and I know fertilizer helps maize, so I will buy a little DAP and urea from the cooperative, but only what I can afford for this small area. I cannot irrigate here — I depend on the belg and meher rains like everyone in my kebele. I will use manure from our animals and try to get improved seed from the extension office, but I will not hire labor for such a small plot when my family can manage it.
